title: This $199.90 iOS scanner app is only $25 for 2 days
content:
Macworld

TL;DR: Scan and edit documents on your iPhone or iPad with a lifetime iScanner subscription on sale for $25 through October 11.

If you don’t own a scanner, turning a signed contract or tax form into a clean, editable PDF is remarkably inconvenient. iScanner turns your iPhone or iPad into a document scanner and PDF editor, and a lifetime subscription is on sale for $24.97 (reg. $199.90) for the next two days.

Point your camera at a page, and iScanner finds the edges and crops the scan for you. Curved book pages and skewed shots get straightened automatically. Text recognition works in more than 20 languages, so you can copy words out of a scan instead of retyping them. When you’re done, you can export the file as a PDF, JPG, DOC, XLS, PPT, or TXT.

You don’t even need to leave the app to edit your scans. You can sign a document, blur an account number before sharing it, fill in forms, and merge several scans into one file. Folders keep your scans organized, and you can lock private files behind a PIN.

iScanner also has modes for scanning ID cards and passports, reading QR codes, measuring objects, and solving math problems.

Desktop scanners might be done.

Get an iScanner lifetime subscription on sale for $24.97.

Sale ends October 11 at 11:59 p.m. PT.
